name: Rice sheets with pork offal
summary: Fine rice sheets brushed with scallion fat, served with pork heart, liver, blood sausage, and intestine, herbs, and chili fish sauce. Vietnam Tourism says people also take a bowl of pork-blood and minced-pork porridge with it.
origin: Vietnam Tourism’s culinary journey, in the coastal half of the post-merger province.
howToEat: Eat the sheets with the offal, herbs, and chili fish sauce. The porridge cooked with blood and minced pork is the side the article names.
where: The coastal cuisine in that culinary journey. A street is Check on arrival. An hour is Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Bánh hỏi lòng heo is fine rice sheets, scallion fat, and pork offal, with a blood-porridge side. Vietnam Tourism’s Gia Lai culinary journey. A price is Check on arrival.
